title: メモリーズオフ

layouts.notes: The window's three rows are written over in place and not ended, so the row lengths cut them. A page is whole in memory as soon as it starts to type, so there is no `shown`: the typing position is kept per segment (u16 at 0x80074CCC, rows revealed at 0x80074CD0). The name buffer keeps the last speaker during narration; the flag at 0x8007253D is the name plate. A wrapped row ends in the game's padding (full-width spaces), which the cleanup drops. Found by replaying the opening headless (docs/replay.md) and checked in a reader during play; choices not reached.
